notes: Transcript on the donor idiom: the column owns its one px-4 gutter and every block, stamp, chip, divider and spawn row drops its own; prompts sit in a rounded-xl bubble with the turn stamp row always reserved so spacing holds without a time; tool invocations, todo lists and code blocks share the rounded-[10px] hairlined bg-content/6 card with EditRow and its corner chip; one TodoList renders in both the row and under a tool (text glyphs gone); ErrorChip, QuestionCard and the tool chip take the shared CHIP/CHIP_ON classes and QuestionCard's Other field is the kit Input; diff gutters are select-none tabular-nums and an editable line marks its gutter on hover instead of washing over its tint; the split pane wash is bg-content/5 focused and none otherwise in DiffPane and the terminal dock; the compaction progress is one divider-height row with an inline scaleX bar; the minimap samples ticks at 3px and its tooltip is rounded-xl; the jump-to-latest pill enters on SPRING_PRESS and leaves in 120 ms, size-6 split close; EmptySession titles at text-2xl with chips on the title edge; the arcade's take-control button is a floating rounded-xl glass surface, the stamp buffer is allocated once per grid size and idle boards stop under reduced motion, as does useCountUp; folds unmount on TWEEN_FALLBACK_MS, chevrons turn in 150 ms, colour hovers take the 120 ms default, Shimmer defaults to 1.4 s, diff reveals cap at 300 ms
